title: question.v1
description: The unclear criteria of the requirements and the person's answers (SWE.1 BP1, checkpoint 2): which criteria and glossary terms the check has seen, and each question it raised — a criterion, or a term, whose readings would need different tests — with its readings, each with an example, the proposal and its source, and the person's answer. One YAML file, <requirements_dir>/questions.yaml, written by agent/record_answer_tool.py from the session of agent/clarify_criteria_prompt.md and from the person's answers. That every criterion is checked and every question answered before checkpoint 2 are rules of verify_requirements_approval_gate.

checked.description: Each criterion and glossary term the check has seen, as the SHA-256 of its text: one left unchanged is not asked about again.

about.description: The acceptance criterion (by its requirement and its place, from 1) or the glossary term the question is about.

asked.description: The SHA-256 of the criterion's or term's text when it was asked.

readings.description: The readings, numbered from 1 in this order; the next number is always 'neither: the requirement goes back to be rewritten'.

conflicts.description: The other requirement this reading contradicts, e.g. 'REQ-0049 criterion 1'.

proposal.description: none when nothing approved decides it; else the reading proposed and its source — a diagram message, another requirement, a glossary term.

answer.description: The person's answer: a reading's number, or the one after the last for 'neither'; who gave it; whether it took the proposal.
